# Hibiscus 0.8.30

This update restores reliable AI setup and polishes the assistant, menus, and
window controls.

- Explicitly saving or validating a usable AI provider, or choosing an enabled
  model, now re-enables AI if it was turned off during setup. The assistant
  distinguishes AI being turned off from a missing provider configuration and
  offers an Enable AI action when the selected model is ready.
- AI stays off until you explicitly enable it or configure a usable provider;
  background model discovery does not change that choice or silently replace
  your selected model.
- Provider API-key and model-search fields are easier to focus and use. Model
  search also matches provider names in Settings and the assistant model picker.
- Assistant Plus and model menus no longer compete with input focus. Menus
  dismiss with Escape or an outside click, and the editor AI menu fits its
  contents instead of stretching down the window.
- The sidebar hover menu has its own readable background so note text no
  longer shows through it. Window traffic lights appear only with the permanent
  sidebar; closing it shifts the editor controls left, and reopening it keeps
  all three window buttons aligned.
- Quick Capture and its setup preview now use a Plus icon. Settings sidebar
  icons are centered more consistently within their backgrounds.
- The menu-bar AI action header shows the selected model without a redundant
  AI Actions title. Action feedback uses a rounded shadow with room to render
  without clipping.

If you previously chose to keep AI off, use Enable AI in the assistant or
explicitly save or validate your provider in Settings to resume it. No note
migration is required.
